newsitem.title: SPAIN: Popular to split shares in September.
newsitem.headline: Popular to split shares in September.

text.p: Shareholders in Spain's Banco Popular have approved a four-for-one share split which will take place in the first 10 days of September, national stock market comission CNMV said late Thursday.
In a mandatory note to the CNMV, Popular said the number of shares would increase to 110.775 million from 27.69 million.
The bank also got backing to switch 12.5 billion pesetas from reserves to a special fund to cover an early retirement plan. Plans to do this were announced earlier this year.
Shareholders also gave the go-ahead for plans to continue a buyback programme for the purchase of up to five percent of share capital, which would then be cancelled.
In the past year Popular bought back 1,206,250 shares for 34.99 billion pesetas, as approved by shareholders at the 1996 meeting.
Popular today pays a final dividend of 211.5 pesetas net per share against 1996 results.
